properties.description: The Orange Loop Trail at Christmas Rocks State Nature Preserve features steep inclines. It offers access to a scenic overlook atop a 250-foot-high sandstone formation known as Jacob's Ladder, providing stunning views of the surrounding landscape.

properties.description: The Blue Loop Trail in Christmas Rocks State Nature Preserve is accessible from the end of the Orange Loop Trail. This trail features steep inclines, switchbacks, and passes through wooded areas with sandstone outcroppings and small recess caves.
